<P STYLE="margin: 0"></P>

<P>EXHIBIT 32.1</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; margin: 0; text-indent: 0.5in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; margin: 0; text-indent: 0.5in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: center; margin: 0">PETRONE WORLDWIDE, INC.</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: center; margin: 0">CERTIFICATION PURSUANT TO 18 U.S.C. SECTION 1350,</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: center; margin: 0">AS ADOPTED PURSUANT TO SECTION 906 OF</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: center; margin: 0">THE SARBANES-OXLEY ACT OF 2002</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; margin: 0; text-indent: 0.5in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; margin: 0; text-indent: 0.5in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0; text-align: justify">In connection with the Quarterly&nbsp;Report of PETRONE WORLDWIDE,
INC.&nbsp;(the Registrant) on Form 10-Q for the period&nbsp; ended September 30, 2014 as filed with the Securities
and Exchange&nbsp;Commission on the date hereof (the Report), I, Victor Petrone, Jr., Principal&nbsp;
Executive&nbsp; Officer of the Company, certify,&nbsp; pursuant to 18 U.S.C.&nbsp; ss.1350,&nbsp;as adopted pursuant to
Section 906 of the Sarbanes-Oxley Act of 2002, that:</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; margin: 0; text-indent: 0.5in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; margin: 0">(1)&nbsp; The Report fully complies with the&nbsp; requirements&nbsp;of section 13(a)
or 15(d) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934; and</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; margin: 0; text-indent: 0.5in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; margin: 0">(2)&nbsp; The information&nbsp;contained in the Report fairly&nbsp;presents,&nbsp;in
all material respects, the financial condition and results of operations of the Company.</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; margin: 0; text-indent: 0.5in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; margin: 0">A signed&nbsp;original of this&nbsp;written&nbsp;statement&nbsp;required by Section
906 has been provided&nbsp;to Victor Petrone, Jr. and will be&nbsp;retained&nbsp;by&nbsp;PETRONE WORLDWIDE, INC. and furnished to
the Securities and Exchange Commission or its staff upon request.</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; margin: 0">Dated:&nbsp;October 14, 2014</P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0; text-indent: 0.5in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; margin: 0">By:&nbsp;<U>/s/ Victor Petrone, Jr.</U></P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; margin: 0">Victor Petrone, Jr.</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; margin: 0">Chief Executive Officer</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; margin: 0">(Principal Executive Officer)</P>



<P STYLE="margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; margin: 0"></P>
